name: HyperStar X Duel
source:
Join the first 'HyperStar X Duel Universal Tournament' and look for your childhood friend who taught you how to play the HyperStar X Duel card game and you totally had a crush on!

P. S. It's in space, ace cards fight for real against each other, you might die if you lose. But you made a promise, and that's the most important thing!

[from [url=https://crescendo.itch.io/hyperstar-x-duel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
参加第一届“HyperStar X Duel环球锦标赛”，寻找教你如何玩HyperStar X Duel卡牌游戏并且你彻底迷恋的儿时朋友！

P.S.这是在太空中，王牌卡牌之间的真正的战斗，如果你输了，你可能会死。但你做出了承诺，这才是最重要的！

[来自[url=https://crescendo.itch.io/hyperstar-x-duel]itch.io[/url]]
